speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The clinical triad of a continuous heart murmur (PDA), bluish non-blanching macules (petechiae), and cloudy lenses (cataracts), combined with hearing loss, is classic for this condition.
